subject: Greenleaf onboarding: invite link refreshes after SSO flow
messages:
From: Ellie Martin <ellie.martin@greenleaffoods.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greenleaffoods.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trouble claiming supplier invite (link invalid after SSO)

Hi Vivek,

We got the supplier portal invite you sent this morning, but the link seems to break during our SSO step. Steps we took: click invite -> redirected to corporate SSO -> select account -> redirected back to your portal and we immediately see an error: "Invite token invalid or expired. Please request a new invitation."

I attached a screenshot and pasted the invite URL into invite-link.txt. Can you reissue or advise what we should try? We're trying to finish the onboarding so we can receive POs.

Thanks,
Ellie Martin
Procurement Ops
Greenleaf Foods

Attachments: screenshot-error.png (image), invite-link.txt (text)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Martin <ellie.martin@greenleaffoods.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Trouble claiming supplier invite (link invalid after SSO)

Hi Ellie — sorry you're hitting this. Marissa (account lead) and Laura (onboarding ops) are looped in. A couple quick clarifying q's while we investigate:

- Did you click the invite link from the email on a desktop or mobile device?
- Are you using the company SSO (SAML) that redirects to idp.greenleaffoods.com?
- Can you confirm the exact error message (screenshot helps, you already included one — thanks).

We will try reissuing a fresh invite and check our token TTL and any link-rotation logic. Laura, Marissa — can you check if we have audit logs for the invite token and whether our invite service rotated the token after redirect (we saw a similar symptom once when sticky session headers were stripped by a proxy).

Vivek
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ellie Martin <ellie.martin@greenleaffoods.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:05:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Trouble claiming supplier invite (link invalid after SSO)

Ellie — I've reissued a new invite from the account admin console and set the "Claim expiration" to 72 hours. You should receive a new email titled "Greenleaf — Complete supplier onboarding". A couple of notes for your SSO flow that have caused this before:

- If your IdP is configured to add parameters on redirect (utm-like query params), our invite token parser can fail; we have a redirect sanitizer but it only triggers for known params.
- Corporate reverse proxies sometimes strip or rewrite the session cookie during the SSO hop — that will cause our server to believe the session is new and reject the returned token.

If the new invite fails, please forward the URL back to me. Laura, can your team pull the auth logs for greenleaf email addresses for Oct 20-21 and check whether the relay/ip headers show any proxy rewriting?

—Marissa
Account Executive, Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: reissued-invite-20261021 (note: email invite sent; link in invite-link.txt)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trouble claiming supplier invite (link invalid after SSO)

Looping in infra ops notes from the logs:

- The token that Ellie attempted to redeem (see debug-logs-20261021.txt) was generated at 2026-10-20T15:58:02Z and had a TTL of 15 minutes. We saw a second token created 45s later for the same email address — looks like a background job rotated tokens when it detected a perceived race.
- On the SSO return path the request had no Cookie header when it hit the backend pool (client->LB->our backend). The LB was rewriting SameSite and dropping session id when the Referer included the idp.greenleaffoods.com domain.

Temporary mitigations we applied (10/22 08:10Z):
- Increased invite token TTL to 4 hours for reissued links to reduce timing sensitivity.
- Added a sticky session rule and preserved the cookie header for SSO return URIs matching the pattern /sso/return.
- Sanitized known UTM-ish params so they don't break token parsing.

Next steps (action items):
- Laura: confirm whether Greenleaf saw the new invite and whether their IdP inserted any query params.
- Marissa: confirm customer can now claim; if yes, mark onboarding step complete and document sequence in the account playbook.
- Engineering: plan a small change to not rotate tokens during an in-flight SSO handshake (follow-up ticket created).

-Karthik
Principal Engineer, Infra
Redwood Inference

Attachment: debug-logs-20261021.txt
From: Ellie Martin <ellie.martin@greenleaffoods.com>

Hi all — confirming the new invite worked. I clicked the link from my desktop, SSO redirected as before, and the portal showed "Account claimed". I can now see our supplier profile and a sample PO in the Portal UI.

Thanks for the quick escalation — much appreciated. Please leave the new token TTL at 4 hours for our account while we finish setup.

Ellie

Greenleaf Foods
